articles.title: 'We have lost control': Crypto pioneer warns AI could trigger systemic banking and infrastructure shocks
articles.snippet: Marc van der Chijs sold much of his bitcoin to invest in AI. Now, growing concerns about the technology accompany a move to put some profits back into crypto.

articles.title: 'The orange tie stays': Michael Saylor responds to venture capitalist's bitcoin obituary
articles.snippet: "Bitcoin feels like the CD in the age of Spotify, the DVD in the age of Netflix," wrote Jason Calacanis.

articles.title: DHS’s predictive policing is unconstitutional, un-American and should be stopped
articles.snippet: Targeting Americans based on what their spending habits can tell us about their politics is an abuse of our financial system, writes Coin Center’s Laz Pieper.

articles.title: Bitcoin weathers September storm as rate hikes and Clarity act setback test bulls
articles.snippet: Bitcoin is down just 1.5% in its historically weakest month and remains on track for its first quarterly gain in a year, despite rising rates, surging oil and a stronger dollar.

articles.title: Real stocks are finally coming on blockchain. Here’s how the SEC wants it to work
articles.snippet: The SEC is giving tokenized stocks a regulated U.S. pathway, while keeping trading volumes, access and issuer rights tightly controlled.
